name: USL Integration
description: The Ultimate Shitty List in game: Classic, Challenge and three Spam lists, placements, USL rates, players and changes.

show-placements.name: Show USL placements
show-placements.description: Shows the list icon and USL placement on level cells and level pages.

show-points.name: Show points on level pages
show-points.description: Shows how many USL points a level gives next to its placement.

fake-rate.name: Show USL rates
fake-rate.description: Levels on the list show the demon difficulty and rate (Featured, Epic, Legendary, Mythic) set by the USL team instead of their in-game rating. Only the look changes, your saved levels stay as they are.

issues.info: Report bugs or wrong placements in the USL Discord server.
